submission.justification: D2 has the highest light yield but fails the hard thermal-cycling requirement (30% failures against a 5% limit). Of the designs that pass, D1 gives the most light: 38.6 PE/MeV at 30% coverage, against 25.4 for D3. Its failure rate is 2%. Feedthroughs are sufficient for 30% coverage.

requirements.evidence: D1 at 30% gives 38.6 PE/MeV, the highest among designs that pass the thermal-cycling requirement. D3 gives 25.4.
D1 had 2% failures in a batch of 40 modules. This is a small sample. D2 failed at 30%, so it was excluded.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed designs
